text: Multi-parent idea support: Show all paths to an idea in list view
description:
Ideas can support multiple parents (synergies). Graph view already shows this well.

List view needs enhancement:
- When viewing an idea with multiple supportedIdeas, show all paths
- "This idea supports: [Idea A] [Idea B] [Idea C]"
- Click to navigate to each parent path
- Visual indicator for multi-parent ideas (badge/icon)

Already implemented in data model, just needs UI support.

status.comment: Implemented multi-parent idea support in list view. Added visual badge showing number of parents, expandable section listing all parent ideas with click-to-navigate. Uses purple color scheme to distinguish from children (blue). All 65 frontend tests pass.
